gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.119: A vampire stranded in the Nether can drink from piglins and Hornkin, never the zombified. A bottle of blood holds off starving, barely.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.120: A vampire who taps use twice on their prey grabs it by the throat and drinks fast as they walk. Let go early and it's thrown hard; a well-fed vampire throws it through anything softer than stone.
